stages.title: Run installer
stages.participant: Run curl -fsSL https://kaneclihack.sh/install.sh | sh; complete installation and open Codex.
stages.skill: Check dependencies and discovery; start $hack-os. Reuse tools already installed.
stages.backend: Serve checksum-pinned skill/helper releases; publish the updated bundle and bootstrap handoff.
stages.note: Installer source exists; updated single-skill rollout and clean-machine checks pending.

stages.title: Skill guides signup
stages.participant: Confirm missing profile details; enter passwords and identity proof in the secure browser flow.
stages.skill: Create or recover account through the approved handoff; pair device and verify current identity.
stages.backend: Validate profile, prove existing-account ownership, create account/session, link admission record, issue scoped device session.
stages.note: Browser signup exists. Installer-first registration/session API adapter needs a contract; profile/check is only handle validation.

stages.title: Solo or team via API
stages.participant: Choose solo/create/join/find; confirm membership and final roster.
stages.skill: Call team APIs; read back canonical team ID, slug and role. Preserve successful membership on resume.
stages.backend: Find opted-in teams; atomically create/join; enforce seats, invite expiry, captain permissions and roster lock.
stages.note: GET/POST /api/v1/teams and POST /api/v1/teams/join exist. REST join uses code; MCP uses invite_code. Roster-confirmation adapter still needs checking.

stages.title: Activate event resources
stages.participant: Complete TestMu signup; claim plan; obtain and redeem personal Codex credits.
stages.skill: Read each activation state; guide missing human steps. Continue credit allocation if TestMu claim is temporarily unavailable.
stages.backend: Claim TestMu plan for member email; save result and audit; atomically assign/reuse organizer credit code; stamp activation after required ticks.
stages.note: Server functions exist in event-activation.ts; corresponding skill-facing adapters are not in the inspected MCP list. Code assignment is not proven redemption.

stages.title: Idea → local validator → build plan
stages.participant: Choose the creation and meaningful Kane workflow.
stages.skill: Load the user-supplied validator subskill and analyse the idea locally; refine findings and the Kane feedback loop.
stages.backend: Persist approved idea revisions if requested. Local analysis does not require the hosted validator API; private text stays local.
stages.note: USER WILL SUPPLY the local idea-validator subskill, entrypoint and rubric. Existing hosted idea/team tools do not substitute for this local assessment.

stages.title: Build, test, fix, repeat
stages.participant: Work with Codex + Kane. Return with “$hack-os, ready to submit”.
stages.skill: Save build=building and end the onboarding turn. Resume tests/help when asked; recheck state at submission time.
stages.backend: Persist opted-in run reports and evidence metadata; process validation jobs/tickets, deadline phases and operational health independently.
stages.note: No hours-long sleeping, continuous polling, automatic submission or inferred completion. Existing run/help code can support the build period; service deployment is not verified.

stages.title: POST current team lifecycle status
stages.participant: Continue working, wait for a human action, or resume later; status reporting preserves the current phase.
stages.skill: At turn completion, persist a minimal snapshot; POST when configured; track acknowledgement or pending delivery separately.
stages.backend: Future endpoint authorizes team scope, deduplicates turn events, rejects stale updates, stores current/history and returns acknowledgement/version.
stages.note: ENDPOINT WILL BE PROVIDED. Needs a supported turn-completion adapter to cover turns outside $hack-os. Queue failed sends; never upload transcripts/code or treat status as verified proof. No heartbeat while idle.

stages.title: Upload evidence separately
stages.skill: Prepare files + SHA256 manifest; upload separately; verify returned public URL/digest; retain receipts for linking.
stages.backend: Future upload service issues scoped upload authorization; bucket stores public objects; completion validates type/size/digest and deduplicates.
stages.note: PUBLIC BUCKET API WILL BE PROVIDED LATER. Existing evidence routes store private Blob and are a different integration. Event API outage can leave upload usable; linking waits.

stages.title: Video guideline / skill / upload option
stages.participant: Use the supplied video skill/guideline, record manually, or choose an existing video for upload.
stages.skill: Load the provided video guidance; preview the actual file, upload via the supplied endpoint, then link the acknowledged asset to the team page.
stages.backend: Future upload endpoint issues scoped authorization, validates accepted video/visibility, stores asset and returns URL/receipt for page linkage.
stages.note: USER WILL PROVIDE video skills/guidelines and upload endpoint. Generated draft, local file, uploaded asset and page-linked video are separate states. Do not assume evidence bucket is the video upload endpoint.

stages.title: Create team submission page
stages.participant: Review repo + exact commit, one-pager HTML, video, deck, Kane results and limitations.
stages.skill: Call supplied page API with reviewed artifacts and public evidence references; save receipt and returned /t/{team-id} URL.
stages.backend: Future API creates/updates authorized team page idempotently, links artifacts, handles HTML isolation, visibility, versions/jobs and readback.
stages.note: PAGE API WILL BE SUPPLIED. Existing /t/[slug] is a hub, not evidence that the new artifact-page API exists. Resolve ID/slug mapping and page access in the contract. Include the independent video-upload receipt; the endpoint is still pending.

stages.title: Preflight and final receipt
stages.participant: Captain confirms final submission in browser when preflight is ready.
stages.skill: Show gaps and exact snapshot; hand off as required; read existing receipt instead of repeating finalization.
stages.backend: Check server deadline, team permissions, required artifacts and repo revision; freeze immutable snapshot; return timestamped receipt.
stages.note: Inspected MCP/REST bearer finalize is a browser handoff. Future page creation does not automatically mean submitted.

stages.title: Showcase and judging eligibility
stages.participant: Approve public Ship Page + deck and X post containing BOTH canonical links.
stages.skill: Guide approved API/human publication, then require server X verification and eligibility receipt.
stages.backend: Publish approved assets; validate X author, links, visibility and event timing; apply audited outage exceptions when authorized.
stages.note: Mandatory v2.5 policy remains confirmed. Share/eligibility tools absent from inspected MCP list. New /t page does not silently replace Ship/deck links.
